channel.title: Cork Safety Alerts - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Cork Safety Alerts (corksafetyalerts.com)

item.title: Ireland Launches New Circular Economy Strategy to Cut Waste and Create Jobs
item.description: Ireland launches Circular Economy Strategy 2026-2028, with repair vouchers, product passports and sector targets to cut waste and boost sustainability.

item.title: An Garda Síochána Takes Centre Stage in Major Europol Cross-Border Exercise
item.description: An Garda Síochána played a leading role in Allies 2026, a major Europol cross-border exercise simulating drug trafficking operations across 12 EU countries.

item.title: Multi-vehicle Collision on N28 Northbound
item.description: Reports of a multi-vehicle collision, on the N28 at N28(N) to N40(E) junction (Bloomfield Interchange.) Take care on approach.Source: TII Traffic Alerts, 24 February at 15:11.

item.title: Free Long-Stay Parking Coming to Bandon from Tomorrow
item.description: Free long-stay parking arrives in Bandon tomorrow, with 28 spaces opening at the GAA grounds from 25 February as part of a new pilot scheme.

item.title: Spillage on M8 Northbound
item.description: Reports of spillage, northbound, on the M8 Dublin Motorway between Junction 16 Rathcormac and Junction 15 Fermoy (South) (2 kilometres south of the Rathcormac area). Take care on approach.Source: TII Traffic Alerts, 24 February at 15:52.

item.title: Collision on N40 Eastbound
item.description: Reports of a collision, eastbound, on the N40 South Ring Road between Junction 8 (Douglas Road) and Junction 9 (Bloomfield). Take care on approach.

item.title: Breakdown on N40 Eastbound
item.description: Reports of a breakdown, eastbound, on the N40 South Ring Road between Junction 10 Mahon and Jack Lynch Tunnel West Entrance (Cork). Take care on approach.Source: TII Traffic Alerts, 24 February at 18:17.

item.title: Multi-vehicle Collision on N40 Westbound
item.description: Reports of a multi-vehicle collision, westbound, on the N40 South Ring Road between Junction 9 (N28) Ringaskiddy and Junction 8 Douglas (Cork). Take care on approach.Source: TII Traffic Alerts, 24 February at 18:43.

item.title: Road Closure on N25 Westbound
item.description: Reports of a road closure due to roadworks, westbound, on the N25 between Junction 2 Little Island and Junction 1 (M8/N40) Dunkettle (Cork). Take care on approach.Source: TII Traffic Alerts, 24 February at 21:00.

item.title: Collision at the Sarsfield Road R/A
item.description: Reports of a collision at Sarsfield Road Roundabout. Emergency services are en route. Take care on approach.
